G1_definition: design/41 section 8.3: non-gates P>=.95rec (Boss/x7-x9 >=rec), <=6 farms/chapter; gate lower exempt, farm until clear; all P<=1.10E; E=max(65,rec(1..L))

assumptions.rewards: full authored kills + first-clear gold; normalized run_xp_budget; no gold-rush/dynamic-summon/premium bonuses
assumptions.conditional: all normal/challenge clears assumed 3-star, NOT runtime wins; post-gate path conditional on having passed each gate; unresolved gate cannot be called feasible
assumptions.route: latest previously 3-star-cleared unclaimed challenge first; else immediate predecessor normal repeat
assumptions.gate_budget: gate runs separately counted, including all runs at a dynamically promoted gate; do not consume non-gate chapter budget
assumptions.gate_promotion: any level still below lower bound after chapter remaining budget; 017/074 are candidates, not a whitelist
assumptions.repeat_stars: challenge first +3 once; normal repeat zero
assumptions.repeat_xp: runtime independent mode counts: challenge first 100%; normal/challenge second 50%, later 25%; no repeat first-clear gold
assumptions.challenge_rewards: same authored enemy count and per-enemy gold/XP; current challenge rules change combat, not these rewards
